description: Navigate the Eurostat theme tree. Without theme_code returns the top-level theme folders (Economy, Population, Transport, etc.) — the practical starting points. With a theme_code returns its immediate children: subtheme folders and datasets in that branch. Use this for structured discovery when you know the domain but not the dataset code, or to drill down from a broad topic to a specific dataset. Pair with eurostat_search_datasets for keyword-based discovery. The tree is the dissemination table of contents plus the Comext host's DS-* collections: detailed trade under ext_go_detail (inside ext_go, "International trade in goods") and PRODCOM under prom (inside icts, "Industry, trade and services"). A collection on neither, such as the legacy PRODCOM DS-056120, is not disseminated and appears nowhere in the tree.

theme_code.description: Folder code to expand (e.g., "economy", "reg"). Exact codes take precedence, then case-insensitive matching applies. Omit to list the top-level theme folders.

name: eurostat_browse_themes

catalogueLoadedAt.description: When the catalogue that answered was loaded (ISO 8601). Present only when a refresh failed and that older copy is still in service; omitted otherwise.

comextListMissing.description: True on a browse of ext_go or icts when the Comext dataflow list could not be loaded, so the DS-* collection folder filed there is not listed. Omitted otherwise.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The provided theme_code does not exist in the TOC — or is a Comext folder (ext_go_detail, prom, comext) or DS-* code while the Comext dataflow list cannot be loaded. `not_a_folder`: The provided theme_code identifies a dataset or table entry instead of a folder. `upstream_fault`: The server had no catalogue loaded yet, and Eurostat's table of contents answered HTTP 5xx or could not be reached on every retry, which the error marks retryable. Once a catalogue is loaded, a failed refresh serves that copy instead. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

itemCount.description: Number of items returned in this level.

items.description: Immediate children of the requested theme, or the root themes if theme_code was omitted.
A theme folder, dataset, or table entry.

code.description: Theme or dataset code. Pass to theme_code to drill into a folder, or use as dataset_code for data tools.

dataEnd.description: Most recent data period. Omitted for folders and when not reported.

dataStart.description: Earliest data period (e.g., "1995"). Omitted for folders and when not reported.

hasChildren.description: True when this folder contains sub-items. Only meaningful for type "folder".

obsCount.description: Approximate observation count. Omitted for folders and when not reported.

type.description: Item type: "folder" has sub-items; "dataset"/"table" can be queried for data.

nextStep.description: Suggested next action based on these results. Populated when there is a clear follow-up call.

notice.description: Names each part of the catalogue this listing is missing — the Comext collections, or updates since a refresh failed — and what to do about it. Omitted when the whole catalogue answered.

otherPlacements.description: Breadcrumbs of the other branches that file this same theme_code. Eurostat lists a few folder codes in more than one branch; the items above come from the first one the catalogue lists, which never has fewer children than the branches named here but can list different ones. theme_code takes a bare code, so those branches cannot be addressed directly — browse down to them from the root instead. Omitted when the code has a single placement — the normal case.

items.description: Breadcrumb from root to one other folder carrying the requested code.

parentPath.description: Breadcrumb from root to the requested theme (e.g., ["Database by themes", "Economy and finance"]). Empty when browsing root.

themeCode.description: Folder code that was browsed, or omitted for root.

title: Browse Eurostat Theme Hierarchy
